items.title: Mike Wofford interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Lawrence Olivier or someone talking about that they still get butterflies you know. I believe when he was still alive I think I remember hearing that comment in one interview from him.

ctx.x: Right. Was Ella’s — I had read that she tended to be, even as great as she was, quite nervous about coming on stage.

Yes, she was. She was. If Sarah was, she hid it very well. I was never ever aware of any nervousness. You never know for sure what’s going on inside someone, but Ella was like I think many accomplished actors and actresses and singers, and even people who’ve done it for decades talk about how nervous they are before they go out. Lawrence Olivier or someone talking about that they still get butterflies you know. I believe when he was still alive I think I remember hearing that comment in one interview from him.…
I see you were part of the “All That Jazz” the Grammy award winner. Did you get a Grammy for that?
